android.desc:
Ever wonder which apps are really watching and listening?

Spytrap is a camera and microphone spy detector for Android. It watches your phone's sensors at the system level and tells you the moment any app reaches for them — including the apps running silently in the background that you forgot you installed.

Your phone already knows which app turned on your microphone at 3am. It just never tells you. Spytrap does.

WHAT SPYTRAP DOES
• Detects every camera and microphone access on your phone, in real time
• Flags background access — when an app uses a sensor while you're not even in it
• Alerts you instantly, even when Spytrap is closed or swiped away
• Keeps a clear, timestamped history of which app touched what, and for how long
• Gives every app a trust score, so you can see who deserves access
• Shows one privacy score for your whole phone, at a glance
• Sends a weekly report ranking the apps that used your sensors most

HOW IT WORKS
Spytrap reads Android's own sensor-access signals to see exactly when the camera or mic switches on, and which app is responsible — no guesswork, just the facts your phone usually keeps to itself. When something looks wrong, jump straight to that app's settings to revoke its permission, or mark apps you trust so they stop alerting.

Android's built-in Privacy Dashboard shows roughly a day of history and never warns you. Spytrap alerts you the second it happens and keeps the full record.

WHO IT'S FOR
If you have ever asked "is my phone listening to me?", wondered why an ad appeared right after a conversation, or worried that a hidden app is watching you, Spytrap gives you a straight answer instead of a guess. It is useful as a spyware detector, a microphone detector, a permission manager, and a privacy checkup for a phone you share with family.

YOUR PRIVACY COMES FIRST
Everything Spytrap sees stays on your device. Nothing is ever uploaded, sold, or shared. No account to create, no sign-up, no tracking, no ads, no analytics. A privacy app that collected your data would defeat the point.

One-time purchase. No subscription, no hidden costs.

PERMISSIONS WE USE
• Usage access — so Spytrap can tell which app is using a sensor
• Notifications — so you're alerted the instant it happens
• Background activity — so monitoring never stops

WHAT SPYTRAP IS NOT
